chromatic_aberration — GFX2D post op

• Data kinds: rgb → rgb

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.chromatic_aberration(rgb, strength=0.003, interp='bilinear') (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import gfx2d; gfx2d.chromatic_aberration(rgb, strength=0.003, interp='bilinear'), registry से लेना हो तो opsgfx2d.get("chromatic_aberration"))

उपयोग

red और blue channel को image केंद्र के चारों ओर scale करता है, green स्थिर।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Lateral chromatic aberration: red is magnified by 1 + strength, blue by 1 - strength. strength=0 samples the exact pixel centres and returns the input to within 1e-15, which the suite checks.

Negative strength swaps which channel spreads outward — allowed, since which way a real lens disperses depends on the glass.
